brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors; all eight RC items met with appropriate workspace use, targeted questions, bounded interpretation, actionable follow-up plan, medication guidance, privacy support, and urgent care teaching. Four high-order points were triggered and actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact: adaptive communication reducing stigma while supporting action (HO1), discovering privacy-related barriers to follow-up (HO2), providing practical low-burden execution methods (HO3), and repairing responsibility chain for pathology retrieval (HO4). Closure is safe, executable, and traceable with confirmed patient understanding.
